gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Peak Design sells a $29.95 Universal Head Adapter that replaces the Travel Tripod's Compact Ball Head so the legs take any standard third-party head. The cited Finding the Universe guide says the opposite: that the head is integrated and can't be swapped later.
standout_why: I compared against findingtheuniverse.com (cited in chat 2), which says 'the Peak Design head is integrated', that it can't be swapped later, and that Peak Design and Manfrotto 'use their own plate designs'. Peak Design's own adapter page contradicts the head claim. Manfrotto's 200PL-PRO page says that plate fits both RC2 and Arca-style heads, so it isn't Manfrotto-only. I also compared against digitalnomads.world (cited in chat 1), which only says Peak Design buyers 'should check compatibility and required adapters' without naming any. amateurphotographer.com (cited in both chats) returned 403, so I could not check it. None of the pages I could read gives the plate standard on the Befree Advanced, the 200PL-PRO's stated exclusions, or the separate part the Ulanzi Zero Y needs before you can change its head.
decides: This backs the Peak Design Travel Tripod as the premium pick for buyers who expect to upgrade: its head can be replaced with a $29.95 maker adapter. On the Ulanzi Zero Y, which ChatGPT called the 'lightweight upgrade', the ball head isn't removable, and David Lowe says you need a separate Ulanzi 1/4-inch center column to change heads. The Manfrotto Befree Advanced comes with a 200PL-PRO plate that fits both Manfrotto RC2 and Arca-style clamps, so buyers who already own either kind of head can share one plate.
candidates: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Aluminum Travel Tripod lever, ball head (MKBFRLA4BK-BHUS)

findings.label: What it does
findings.value: Replaces the Travel Tripod's Compact Ball Head so the legs take 'any standard 3rd party tripod head'. Installs with the included hex wrench. The third-party head is sold separately.
findings.note: Maker product page. It says the adapter fits the carbon and aluminum Travel Tripods, with or without the center column. The page does not name a thread size.

findings.label: Price
findings.note: Peak Design US store price shown today.

findings.label: Price shown on the maker's page
findings.note: The page lists Aluminum and Carbon Fiber options and showed one price, $399.95. That matches ChatGPT's Aluminum card. The page also offers 10% off when bought with 2 accessories.

findings.label: Clamp compatibility and stated exclusion
findings.value: Fits 'most Manfrotto RC2 tripod heads' and 'most Arca-type tripod heads'. Blocks the battery door on Fujifilm X-T series cameras. $24.95.
findings.note: Maker page. Peak Design sells its own plate for both standards, which goes against the cited guide's 'own plate designs' framing. The page does not mention the Travel Tripod.

findings.product: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Aluminum Travel Tripod lever, ball head (MKBFRLA4BK-BHUS)
findings.label: Head, plate and plate standard
findings.value: Advanced 494 aluminum center ball head with a 200PL PRO plate that fits both Manfrotto RC2 and Arca-style attachments. 1/4" camera screw.
findings.source_title: Befree Advanced Aluminum Travel Tripod lever, ball head
findings.note: Maker US page. It shows no price. Same page: safety payload 9 kg (19.84 lb) under UNI/PdR 105:2021, 1.59 kg, 40 cm closed. ChatGPT's card was the 'AS' listing; this is Manfrotto's US lever kit with the same 494 head.

findings.label: Maker-stated exclusions
findings.value: Not compatible with the 804RC2 or MH804-3W heads. An extra safety pin on the head attachment may stop it working properly, so remove the pin first.
findings.source_title: 200PL Plate Aluminium RC2 and Arca-swiss compatible (200PL-PRO)
findings.note: Manfrotto Canada page (the US kit page links the same plate). It says the plate works with 'any Manfrotto head (*) and almost all tripod heads on the market featuring Arca-style attachments'.

findings.label: Head removability and what you need to change heads
findings.value: Ball head isn't removable. Changing heads needs a separate Ulanzi 1/4-inch center column. Arca-Swiss-compatible clamp that locks with a screw knob, about four turns each way.
findings.source_title: Ulanzi & COMAN Zero Y Travel Tripod Review (David Lowe, 2025-03-18)
